name: Fair Court artisan
title: Artisan of Evenfall
examine: An artisan of the Fair Court, at work on something that will outlive every customer it ever has. This does not seem to hurry anyone.
lines: Mind the planters. They are older than your town.
We do not shout our wares. The work speaks at its own pace.
The Gallery is not a market. Coin is welcome. Hurry is not.
